bead.title: evolve: specify metered routing opt-in
bead.description:
<context-digest>Amend routing specs after DDx autorouting selected a pay-per-token Opus route under policy=default. Relevant artifacts: FEAT-004, ADR-009, ADR-011, SD-005, CONTRACT-003, docs/routing. Desired contract: pay-per-token default-deny for unpinned autorouting; exact pins can consider metered providers; policy requirements beat pins; power bounds remain soft scoring inputs; cheapest-qualified ranking must be defined against policy power fit and capability gates.</context-digest>
Thread metered routing opt-in and model-selection algorithm through affected governing artifacts.
bead.acceptance: Affected routing specs consistently define metered default-deny opt-in, unpinned semantics, soft power scoring, and cheapest-qualified model selection; review pass reports no unresolved contradictions
